title: Benchmark Accuracy Score
description: A capability's accuracy is measured on a fixed benchmark suite, producing a score with confidence intervals. Published intervals keep a 94% from being mistaken for a 99%. Teaching ladder: rank 1 — the concept in its simplest, most direct form.

demo.title: Runnable code demo — Benchmark Accuracy Score
demo.program:
# Capability confidence and evidence: Benchmark Accuracy Score
evidence = {"accuracy": 0.9, "freshness": 0.8, "coverage": 0.7}
weights = {"accuracy": 0.5, "freshness": 0.3, "coverage": 0.2}
score = sum(evidence[k] * weights[k] for k in evidence)
print("confidence score: %.2f  (record: 0.94 +/- 0.02)" % score)
print("evidence:", evidence)
print("calibration:", "quarterly re-benchmark")
assert 0.0 <= score <= 1.0
print("OK - confidence backed by evidence, within bounds")
